qs.s: Ce livre propose une bonne ___ à la peinture pour les débutants.
qs.en: This book offers a good introduction to painting for beginners.

qs.en: She took an introduction to computing last weekend.

qs.s: L'___ des nouveaux membres du club aura lieu samedi soir.
qs.en: The initiation of the club's new members will take place Saturday evening.

qs.en: During the initiation ceremony, the recruits took an oath in front of the veterans.

qs.en: He offers a free introduction to beginners every Saturday.

qs.en: To his great astonishment, he passed the exam without having studied.

qs.en: She couldn't hide her astonishment upon hearing the news.

qs.en: The astonishment showed on his face when he opened the letter.

qs.en: He showed a deep astonishment upon discovering the truth.

qs.s: Sa robe de mariée était ornée de fine ___ faite à la main.
qs.en: Her wedding dress was trimmed with fine handmade lace.

qs.en: This black lace shawl comes from Spain.

qs.s: ___ dentelle de cette nappe est faite à la main.

qs.en: She wears a piece of white lace around her neck.
